decision: Adopt for integrated candidate, subject to normal runtime and Web verification
observed: All four foreground boulders acquire visible mineral structure at gameplay scale. Close views retain the authored broad planes, with restrained grain and strata rather than the previous smooth clay-like surface.
scope: New generated texture, world-space triplanar sampling, albedo/roughness variation and shallow luminance-derived relief; original geometry, vertex paint, authored base colours and lights retained.
import: Original 1254x1254 PNG copied unchanged. Unity importer produces mipmapped 1024x1024 sRGB DXT1 on Windows, trilinear filtering and anisotropy 4.
limitations: Transforms, camera and light checks pass, but repeated captures are not pixel-identical. Path A/A mean absolute RGB difference is 0.565 byte levels; see pixel-comparison.json.
No obvious straight seam was seen in the inspected close views; all angles and texture tile boundaries are not exhaustively verified.
Dynamic shimmer and final integrated performance remain to be tested.
Remaining foliage geometry is visibly simplified; this material improvement does not establish overall superiority to the reference.
